component.name: Pereplyot
component.summary: Standalone PDF and EPUB reader with annotations

description.p: Pereplyot (переплёт — Russian for "binding") is a standalone PDF and EPUB reader: highlight, underline, strike, and leave freestanding notes, with full-text search, continuous scroll, and resumed reading position. No vault to set up — just open a file.

ul.li: Open a PDF or EPUB by file picker, drag-and-drop, or "Open With".
Highlights, underlines, strikes, notes, and bookmarks, with export to Markdown.
In-document search, continuous scroll, facing-pages view, and zoom-to-fit for PDFs.
Rotate and invert-colours (night reading) for PDF; Light/Sepia/Dark reading themes and font choice for EPUB.
A page-thumbnail grid, click-to-turn page zones, and keyboard/mouse page and chapter navigation.
Reading position and annotations remembered per document automatically.
A Library shelf for documents you keep, separate from History's record of everything you've opened.

description.p: 0.5.0 "Turned Leaf" — page thumbnails moved into the Contents sidebar as a second tab alongside Outline, instead of a separate popup window. Fixed a real bug where reopening a document showed the right page number but the wrong page content, always landing back on page 1 instead of resuming where you left off.

0.4.1 "Slim Gutter" — both readers' chrome is consolidated down to one header row and one status-bar row per tab, instead of two header rows and (for the PDF reader) three bottom rows, leaving more of the window for the document itself. The PDF reader's search bar and the reader window's version/changelog button both moved into its status bar. Also fixes the Contents sidebar toggle's icon sometimes rendering as a generic "missing icon" glyph in icon themes without `sidebar-show-symbolic` under that exact name.

0.4.0 "Shared Binding" — Kartoteka and Sputnik now launch this app directly to open a document, instead of each embedding an aging pinned copy of the reader. New command-line modes route annotations, reading position, and the page-numbering override straight into Kartoteka's vault or Sputnik's course-material store, so opening a citation or material from either app behaves exactly as it always has — just with this app's reader instead of a stale embedded one. Also fixes a bug where closing the reader via its window's own close button (rather than an explicit tab-close) silently never saved your reading position.

0.3.0 "Folded Corner" — bookmarks, PDF rotate and invert-colours (night reading), a page-thumbnail grid and click-to-turn page zones, EPUB reading themes (Light/ Sepia/Dark) and font choice, reading-progress percentages, and Markdown export of notes and highlights. Also adds fullscreen/maximize buttons, a version/changelog button on the reader window itself, and fixes the Contents toggle disappearing for documents with no outline/table of contents.

0.2.0 "Shared Shelf" — History is now shared across every app that embeds the reader: opening a document from Kartoteka or Sputnik shows up in Pereplyot's History too. Also fixes Pereplyot sometimes failing to fully close when opened purely to view one file from another app.

0.1.1 "True Margin" — a duplicate "Reader" title, keyboard page navigation that never actually fired, and a misplaced Notes sidebar toggle, all fixed; hamburger menu and status bar now match the rest of the suite.

0.1.0 "Quiet Spine" — first release: a standalone PDF/EPUB reader built around the same reader widget Kartoteka and Sputnik embed, with a Library/History shelf, zoom-to-fit, and keyboard page navigation.
